characters.name: Konen
characters.description: A middle-aged woman with a stern and honest demeanor, indicative of her frugal and hardworking nature. She has a stout build, a kind but firm facial expression with wrinkles showing wisdom and toil. Her hair is tied back in a tight bun under a simple headscarf. Dressed in plain, earth-toned garments suitable for working in the countryside, she carries a basket or a walking stick as she travels through a lush, green forest with tall trees.

characters.name: Bjørnen
characters.description: A large, imposing bear characterized by its thick, shaggy brown fur and massive stature. It has a broad snout and small, intelligent eyes that hold an inquisitive expression. The bear stands on its hind legs, adding to its intimidating presence, while the forest in the background complements its natural setting.

characters.name: Ulven
characters.description: A sleek and cunning wolf with a lean, sinewy build. Its fur is a mix of grays and whites, giving it a well-camouflaged appearance in the forest environment. The wolf's eyes are sharp and calculating as it speaks to the woman, with its alert ears and pointed snout suggesting a readiness to pounce.

characters.name: Ræven
characters.description: A sly and clever-looking fox with a lithe, agile body and rich reddish-orange fur. Its eyes sparkle with mischief and intelligence, and it offers a smooth, silky voice as it converses with the woman. The bushy tail, with a conspicuous white tip, hints at its ingenuity and future mischief. The fox stands with an almost aristocratic posture against a backdrop of farm animals.
